args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 18% since its deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions to restore service.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified: all three regions now report v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2%.

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: I did not deploy v2.3.1 again or attempt any fix forward — the unhealthy version remains the known-bad release, and the incident is open for follow-up investigation.
